newsitem.title: NORWAY: Phillips says restarted Ekofisk field at 1240 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Phillips says restarted Ekofisk field at 1240 GMT.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said on Tuesday it had restarted oil production at the North Sea Ekofisk oilfield and hoped to reach normal output later in the day.

"We resumed production at 13.40 p.m. (1240 gmt)," Phillips spokesman Sander Bull-Gjertsen said. "We anticipate we will reach normal production in three hours and anticipate 10 to 20 percent flush production."

The 350,000 barrel per day development was shut in at 0400 GMT last Tuesday after a gas leak was detected in an oil pipeline. The restart had been planned for the weekend but was delayed because of problems fitting new parts into the pipeline.
Output from third party fields -- British Petroleum Co Plc's Gyda and Ula and Amoco Corp's Valhall and Hod -- and the Statpipe gas line was uninterrupted by the unscheduled shutdown.
